title: A $250 million round does not update the client model.
friendlyTitle: A $250 million raise does not update the client spreadsheet.
summary: Model ML, a London startup that builds agents for financial models, pitch decks, and due-diligence reports, raised $250 million in a Series B at a $1.5 billion valuation. General Atlantic and QED Investors co-led the round. The company says the agents sit in a client's Excel and PowerPoint and update the files when a deal changes.
